RCA: Mumbai West 4G Cluster Outage (INC-2026-0142)

Document ID: RCA_INC_2026_0142

Category: C08 — Network Coverage & Outages

Department: Network

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Incident Reference

INC-2026-0142

Problem Statement

A ~3-hour 4G outage affected approximately 40 sites in Mumbai West circle.

Root Cause

Third-party road excavation work severed the primary fibre backhaul without prior utility-clearance coordination with NovaTel's infrastructure team.

Contributing Factors

No automatic failover to microwave backhaul was configured for this cluster.

Utility-excavation notification process with local municipal bodies had a gap for this corridor.

Corrective Actions

Configure automatic microwave backhaul failover for all clusters currently on single fibre path (target: 60 days).

Establish a proactive excavation-notification liaison with municipal authorities for high-risk corridors (target: 90 days).

Add this fibre route to the priority physical-protection (route diversity) programme.

Status

Actions 1 and 2 in progress; owner: Network Infrastructure team.
